mathematical_scope.progression_definition: a, a+d, ..., a+(k-1)d with integer a>=1, d>=1 and final element<=N; no modular wraparound.
mathematical_scope.family_definition: Every distinct admissible subset of [1,N], including the empty set; no symmetry quotient.
mathematical_scope.rank_order: Decreasing element membership bits, LO before HI; zero-based, either over the full family or one stated cardinality.

actual_execution.timing_scope: Single V8 observations, not benchmarks. Construction timings exclude explicit snapshot/summary retention. Reader query timing includes retaining returned calls and excludes the final full snapshot.
